Congratulations to @UnionCoalition, @seiu_uhw, and @aboutKP on their hard work to reach this historic tentative agreement! 
 
What they've achieved here in Oakland is great news for frontline workers, for Kaiser and the patients in their collective care.

Early in my career, I fought alongside workers to help them exercise their power.

When workers find their voice, it leads to strong communities and stronger democracy. This is what the Biden-Harris administration is fighting for. We have your back.

Workers need to feel safe and secure when they exercise their rights under the law.
 
And we are working hard every day to make sure all workers—including immigrant workers—can participate in our investigations without fear of retaliation.

Nobody should be exploited at work because of their immigration status.

The Biden-Harris administration is empowering workers and improving workplace conditions by enabling all workers, including noncitizens, to exercise their legal labor rights.

As @SEIU and @aboutKP negotiated their union contract, I met Angela. At Kaiser Permanente, she works with patients and serves on her Union Executive Board. Through this, she has fought for fairness, equality and inclusion for all.
 
Thank you for all you do. #WomensHistoryMonth https://t.co/dVhvIlCIoe

Kevin Weikle is a 34-year-old former coal miner in West Virginia with black lung. His story, and others like it, are the reason @MSHA_DOL issued this new silica rule, which is estimated to save more than 1,000 lives and prevent illness for thousands more.
https://t.co/26Z8bcjBbk

No one’s mental health should depend on whether they can afford to get care, but for too long and for too many families, getting care for mental health and addiction has been harder than it should be. Not on our watch.
Today we issued a rule that requires plans and insurance companies to treat mental health needs like physical health needs.
